errors.text_span: 但各组内柱子按图例顺序从左至右排列
errors.evidence: The description states that the bars within each group are arranged according to the left-to-right order of the legend. The legend is arranged in a 2x3 grid. A left-to-right reading of the legend (top row first) would be Original, TransE, ConvE, etc. However, the actual order of the bars is Original, Random, TransE, TransR, ConvE, SemNE. This order does not match a simple left-to-right reading of the legend.
